C-FOCUS-CANON-COMPLETE.Summary: Close the focus-and-typography canon debt of wave-5 bundle D: the visible-keyboard-focus canon (C-SETTINGS-KEYBOARD-FOCUS, extended by C-COMPACT-WINDOWS-FIT) and the C-38 chrome-typography rule were delivered to a named list of controls and surfaces instead of to the class, so the Settings-window theme tile radiogroup still strips its own focus indication with `all: unset` while its Quick Settings twin carries the canon outline (the two-copy asymmetry flipped sides), the C-38 range stepper buttons and the buttonRow push button are likewise bare (and the Quick Settings width stepper inherits the same gap through the shared component), the unsaved-changes dialog sets font sizes but no font family and inherits the user-agent stack instead of var(--chromeFontFamily) (the scout's .el-message-box anchor is superseded: FIX-011 replaced that surface with the imperative .ag-unsaved-close-dialog, and the defect class survives on the live dialog), and the titlebar theme-toggle e2e selection matches the localized title attribute ("Theme") — a pattern eight e2e specs share, so all of them miss the button under any non-en locale (ru renders "Тема: …"). This change extends the canon to the class — every keyboard-focusable button-like control of the Settings control set carries the two-CSS-pixel prefAccent outline at the one-CSS-pixel offset when :focus-visible, with no tabindex change, no focus manager and no geometry change — extends the C-38 chrome font list to the live unsaved-close dialog, and replaces the locale-dependent selector with a data-testid hook following the modeChips precedent, pinned by real-keyboard checkKeyboardFocus routes with before/focused captures in Paper and Ink, by a locale-rotation run (language ru) and by a computed font-family assertion on the open dialog; red-first where behavior changes, recorded honestly where it cannot.

Goals.Goal: The canon extended to the class (F-006/F-007 remainder). Every keyboard-focusable button-like control of the shared Settings control set carries the canon outline when :focus-visible: three new file-local rules in the three owners still missing it — .pref-tab-page--appearance .theme-family-tile:focus-visible (inside START_BLOCK_SWATCH_GRID_METRICS), .pref-range-item .pref-stepper-btn:focus-visible (inside START_BLOCK_STEPPER_METRICS) and .pref-button-item .pref-button:focus-visible (inside START_BLOCK_BUTTON_METRICS) — each `outline: 2px solid var(--prefAccent); outline-offset: 1px` per the canon Architecture, keyboard-only (:focus-visible, never :focus), no tabindex, no listeners, no geometry or layout change (outline paints outside the box model; the settings-shell overflow walker must stay green). The two copies of the theme radiogroup become symmetric in the delivered direction (both copies outline; the is-selected ring stays the distinct selection state per the viewTab comment canon), and both consumers of the stepper (Settings rows, Quick Settings width row) inherit through the shared component. The already-covered members (switch, select, segments, sheet close, toolbar tabs, export actions) stay byte-identical.

The dialog typography on the chrome stack (F-008 remainder, re-derived).
